nodes.description: mapping(bytes32 => uint256) public _userBalances storing per-account ether balances
mapping(bytes32 => address) public _usersByAddress mapping account names to authorized wallets
mapping(address => bool) public _oracles whitelist of oracle addresses allowed to approve accounts
address internal owner, privileged address set at construction
constructor: sets owner = msg.sender and whitelists owner as oracle
enableOracle(address) external onlyOwner: adds an address to the oracle whitelist
disableOracle(address) external onlyOwner: removes an address from the oracle whitelist, reverting for non-existing oracles and for the owner
deposit(bytes32) external payable: credits msg.value to the named account balance
withdraw(bytes32) external: verifies caller owns the named account and transfers the stored balance to msg.sender
approveAddress(address,bytes32) external onlyOracles: binds a wallet address to an account name
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership, oracle and account-ownership authorization
payable(_usersByAddress[account]).transfer(_userBalances[account]): external value transfer executed before the sender balance is zeroed
_userBalances[account] += msg.value in deposit: unchecked arithmetic state update on a caller-chosen account key
address oracle parameter of enableOracle, written into the _oracles whitelist
address oracle parameter of disableOracle, used to look up and clear the _oracles entry
bytes32 account parameter of deposit, used as the key credited in _userBalances
bytes32 account parameter of withdraw, used to look up _usersByAddress and _userBalances
address wallet parameter of approveAddress, stored as the authorized wallet of an account
bytes32 account parameter of approveAddress, key under which the wallet is bound

edges.reason: constructor assigns the untrusted caller msg.sender to the owner state variable, establishing contract ownership
enableOracle is gated by the onlyOwner modifier comparing owner to the untrusted msg.sender
disableOracle is gated by the onlyOwner modifier comparing owner to the untrusted msg.sender
approveAddress is gated by the onlyOracles modifier indexing _oracles with the untrusted msg.sender
withdraw requires _usersByAddress[account] to equal the untrusted msg.sender before paying out
deposit attributes the credited funds to the untrusted msg.sender in the emitted DepositEvent
constructor initialization flow writes the owner state variable used by every onlyOwner authorization check
constructor initialization flow whitelists the deployer as an oracle in _oracles
enableOracle writes true into the privileged _oracles whitelist for the supplied address
disableOracle clears the _oracles whitelist entry after validating it exists
the _oracles whitelist is read in the onlyOracles modifier to authorize approveAddress callers
withdraw reads _usersByAddress[account] to verify the caller is the authorized wallet of the account
withdraw reads _userBalances[account] to determine the amount to transfer
the stored balance from _userBalances[account] is the value passed to the external transfer
the external value transfer can invoke code on the destination address that re-enters withdraw before _userBalances[account] is set to zero, violating checks-effects-interactions ordering
withdraw resets _userBalances[account] to zero only after the external transfer has completed
deposit performs the balance credit operation _userBalances[account] += msg.value
the unchecked += credit writes the accumulated value into the _userBalances state mapping
the caller-supplied account key from the deposit parameter selects which _userBalances entry is credited
the caller-supplied account key from the withdraw parameter selects the _usersByAddress entry used for authorization
withdraw reads _usersByAddress[account] again as the recipient of the transfer
approveAddress writes the wallet into _usersByAddress under the account key
the wallet parameter of approveAddress is the value stored into _usersByAddress
the account parameter of approveAddress is the key used when storing into _usersByAddress
the oracle parameter is consumed by enableOracle before being written to _oracles
the oracle parameter is consumed by disableOracle for existence checks and whitelist removal
the account parameter is consumed by the payable deposit function
the account parameter is consumed by the withdraw function
the wallet parameter is consumed by the oracle-gated approveAddress function
the account parameter is consumed by the oracle-gated approveAddress function

normalization_plan.reason: the oracle parameter only exists to feed the enableOracle whitelist write and carries no independent authorization semantics
the oracle parameter only exists to feed the disableOracle whitelist removal and its existence check
the account parameter is only the mapping key for the deposit credit, so it collapses into the deposit function node
the account parameter is only the mapping key for the withdraw authorization and payout, so it collapses into the withdraw function node
the wallet parameter is only the stored value of the oracle-gated approveAddress write and collapses into that function node
the account parameter is only the storage key of the oracle-gated approveAddress write and collapses into that function node
